stem.text: The volume of carbon dioxide collected by reacting $0.100\,\text{mol}$ of magnesium carbonate with $50.0\,\text{cm}^{3}$ of $1.00\,\text{mol dm}^{-3}$ sulfuric acid is measured against time. The volume produced is plotted against time and the line labelled P on the graph is obtained.

stem.alt: Graph of volume of CO2/cm3 against time/s. Curve P levels off earlier at a lower volume; straight line Q rises to a higher final volume. Both start at the origin.

stem.text: The experiment is repeated using $0.100\,\text{mol}$ of the same magnesium carbonate, and a different sample of acid. All other conditions remain the same. Plotting these results gives the line labelled Q.
Which sample of acid could give the line labelled Q?
